title: Host re-test targets — every URL this project could NOT read (or could read only through the rendering fetch tool) is re-tested from the GitHub-hosted runner by scripts/probe-hosts.mjs
method: Each target is fetched with the project user-agent, then (only if the answer is a 403/503 or a bot interstitial) with a browser-like header profile; targets marked render:true are additionally rendered in headless Chrome when a binary exists on the runner. The probe records status codes, interstitial type, <title> and a 300-character text sample per attempt. It never admits a source by itself: a 'reachable' verdict is the cue for a human-in-the-loop session to fetch the page, read it and write the observed text into data/sources/master.json.
